styles.name: Mist & prints
styles.summary: A low-contrast twilight dark that warms to a peach glow at the top; calm capitals, hairline rules, flyers framed like prints.

styles.name: Dusk editorial
styles.summary: Warm brown-charcoal with amber, square corners, serif headings and italic labels; a quiet, magazine-like dark.

styles.name: Forest notes
styles.summary: Deep green-grey with sand and sage, dashed notebook rules and lower-case labels; outdoorsy and calm.

styles.name: Paper cards
styles.summary: Cream paper with a muted rust accent, serif type, floating light cards and a pill-shaped header.

styles.name: Mist float
styles.summary: The dawn-mist dark with big rounded floating cards, friendly sentence-case type and a pill header.

styles.name: Sage soft
styles.summary: Pale sage with a faint paper grain, serif headings, dashed rules and matted flyers; a light, earthy look.

styles.name: Cobalt night
styles.summary: Deep navy with a clear cobalt-blue accent and an aqua second colour; soft corners, floating cards, matte flyers.

styles.name: Ember
styles.summary: Near-black warm charcoal with a hot vermilion accent; keeps the bold capitals and square corners, so it still feels like a workout group.

styles.name: Daylight teal
styles.summary: Bright white and pale aqua with a deep teal accent and coral highlights; round cards and a floating pill header. Clean and modern.

styles.name: Plum & rose
styles.summary: Dark aubergine with a rose-pink accent and lavender second colour; serif headings, italic labels, hairline rules.

styles.name: Volt
styles.summary: Graphite with an electric lime accent: sporty and high-energy. Bold capitals, square corners, dashed rules.

styles.name: Blueprint
styles.summary: Pale drafting-paper blue with a faint grid, royal-blue accent and safety-orange highlights; lower-case mono labels, dashed rules.

styles.name: Deep sea
styles.summary: Dark teal with an aqua accent and sand highlights; serif headings, floating cards, pill header. Calm and a bit nautical.

styles.name: Sunrise
styles.summary: Warm cream fading from peach, with a violet accent and tangerine highlights; rounded cards, serif headings, italic labels.
